run_non_max_suppression: run non_max_suppression to prune overlapping bounding boxes by score and IOU threshold
run_multi_class_non_max_suppression: run multi_class_non_max_suppression to select top boxes independently per class
compute_iou_scores: compute pairwise intersection-over-union scores between two box collections
sort_boxes_by_field: sort boxes and associated fields by a scalar field in ascend or descend order
clip_boxes_to_window: clip bounding box coordinates to a window and filter out zero-area boxes
